title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
note: Abstract summarised for the offline demo corpus.
abstract: Large pre-trained language models store factual knowledge in their parameters but cannot easily update it and tend to hallucinate. The authors combine a pre-trained sequence-to-sequence generator with a dense retriever over a Wikipedia index, so the model conditions each generation on retrieved passages. Retrieval is trained jointly with generation as a latent variable. The hybrid model sets state of the art on several open-domain question answering benchmarks and produces more specific, diverse and factual text than a purely parametric baseline.
